title: Configurational Pathways to Firm Innovation Across Europe
description: Research software for a survey-design-aware firm-level fsQCA study of innovation across European macroregions. The release includes weighted set-theoretic estimators with explicit pooled estimands, intermediate solutions with core/peripheral classification, declared analytical samples with recorded attrition, directed term-level configuration portability with bootstrap uncertainty, a wired robustness suite, and automated parity against the CRAN QCA package as the canonical engine. It contains no empirical findings: raw or case-level World Bank Enterprise Survey microdata is not included, and the variable mappings and calibration anchors remain unresolved.

creators.name: Ribeiro, Diogo
creators.affiliation: ESMAD - School of Media Arts and Design, Polytechnic of Porto

notes: Synthetic data and synthetic outputs are included only to validate the software pipeline. Licensed WBES microdata must be obtained separately under the applicable access terms and must not be committed to this repository.
